rules.name: SEVERE_INTERVENTION
rules.description: Drowsiness is severe, or the damped fatigue/drowsiness blend reaches the severe cut-point.

rules.name: NO_PRACTICAL_ACTION_FALLBACK
rules.description: Blend reaches the proposal cut-point but no actionable rest spot is reachable.

rules.name: REST_PROPOSAL
rules.description: Blend reaches the proposal cut-point and a rest spot is reachable.

rules.name: SOFT_WARNING
rules.description: Blend reaches the reaction point but not the proposal cut-point.

rules.name: NO_TRIGGER
rules.description: Catch-all: blend is below the reaction point.

message.ja: 長時間の運転が続いています。近くの休憩施設でご休憩をお勧めします。
message.en: You have been driving for a long time. We recommend resting at the nearby facility.

_comment: Scenario: UC-01 fatigue/drowsiness with staged recovery options (M7 Task 12).
This scenario is derived from uc01_fatigue_friend_drive_v0_1 and adds a
recovery_options array so that accept_rest triggers a staged recovery sequence
instead of completing the run immediately (the pre-M7 back-compat path).
nap_karaoke        — long rest: wakefulness (MOVING) → nap 3 ticks → karaoke 3 ticks
convenience_stretch — short rest: wakefulness (MOVING) → stretch 2 ticks
postpone           — postpone=true, no stages (acts as continue driving)
Proposal timeline (identical to friend_drive — same profile, route, presets):
Tick ~29: declarative_rule fires REST_PROPOSAL (high fatigue + moderate drowsiness).
rest spot at 60 km, ~30 min ahead.
After accept_rest(nap_karaoke): wakefulness until 60 km → nap (3 ticks STOPPED) →
content (3 ticks STOPPED) → resuming → route completion.
uc01_fatigue_friend_drive_v0_1 is left UNTOUCHED (no recovery_options) so that
existing tests that call accept_rest expecting immediate completion still pass.
allowed_actions includes decline (M7 requirement) in addition to accept_rest/postpone.
